en:
Oh my! You all voted correctly! What an
unexpected and unpredictable outcome!

The blackened who killed Ryoma Hoshi
is Kirumi Tojo, the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Maid<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
Yayyyy! Bravo, bravo!

Phew! Thank goodness we managed
to get through the class trial again!

Th-There's nothing good about this
at all...!

*sob, sniffle...* Wh-Why...
Why did it have to be Kirumi...?
Truly, this result was unexpected.
How can you be so calm about it...?

But...Gonta no can believe it...
Kirumi was so helpful...for everyone...
Same Kirumi...is also culprit!?
Hey, hey, how long have you been lying to us?

Is that why you took such good care of us...?
So you could deceive everyone?
You mean she's not my mom!?
She was never your fuckin' mom!

Hey, Kirumi. Tell me...
Why?

You were always thinking about everyone
around you... How could you kill someone?

Puhuhu... Human beings have always
been selfish, self-centered creatures.
That's why I hate humans!

They burn down the forests we call home!
They pollute the rivers we drink from!
I'll never forgive humans!

But is that really a reason to destroy them?
Some humans are really nice!

Shut up, shut up, shut up!
Enough with the commentary already!

Well Kirumi? Were your feelings towards 
us simply another falsehood?

N-No! It can't be! Say it ain't so!
That...was just another lie, too?

I don't...think so...
I still believe Kirumi cares about us.
...And how would you know?

I can't say for certain, but I can sense
that this trial has been agonizing for her.

You can't say for certain, hm?
That is what a detective would say.
Kirumi...are you upset...

because of the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>people important to you<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

You mean like from the <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive video<CLT=cltNORMAL>?
So Kirumi watched hers after all?

Earlier, Kirumi mentioned that she had
<CLT=cltSTRONG>accepted a request<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

Perhaps <CLT=cltSTRONG>that request<CLT=cltNORMAL> came from an
someone important in her <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive video<CLT=cltNORMAL>?
...Do you have nothing to say for yourself?
No, that's not it. I'm just...lost.

Because if I tell you why I did it, you will
regret what you've just done.
<CLT=cltMIND>Regret...?

Spit it out already. Otherwise...
we can't accept this outcome.
Please, Kirumi...tell us.

I care about you a lot...and I know the
others care about you, too...
So please...!

...Very well, then. If you are all so
desperate to know...

I will consider this a final request, and
tell you everything.

No more lies, then. You better just tell
us the truth, please and thank you.
Yes, I understand...

Your reasoning was exactly right.
The reason I murdered Ryoma...

...was because of what I saw in my
<CLT=cltSTRONG>motive video<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

As I thought. 
You did indeed watch your video.

Does that mean someone broke the agreement
and traded you your <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive video<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

Alright, fess up! Which one of you did it? Close
your eyes and raise your hand if it was you!

Why would the one raising their hand
need to close their eyes...?

That won't be necessary. I did not trade my
<CLT=cltSTRONG>motive video<CLT=cltNORMAL> with anyone.

Huh? If you didn't trade with anyone,
how'd you see your <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive video<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

Perhaps...Kirumi received
her own <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive video<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

Huh? You mean she had her own
<CLT=cltSTRONG>motive video<CLT=cltNORMAL> from the start?

Correct... No one had my <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive video<CLT=cltNORMAL> but
me—the video's intended recipient.
I...have no idea why.

Th-That's not possible!
Monokuma, what the hell's goin' on!?

Hmmm? Y'know, I meant to bring this up
earlier cuz it's been bugging me for a while...

All this talk about videos being switched...
What does that mean, exactly?

Nyeh...don't play dumb. You're the one
who switched up all the <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive videos<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
...No I didn't.
...Huh?
Uhhhh...
Ummm...

Oh? Was I not supposed to ask that?
Did you cubs screw up again, hmmm?
"Not supposed to"?

I-It's all Monophanie's fault! She passed
them out without checking the names!

Whaaaat!? I didn't know! Monotaro
should've checked the names, too!

Wait a minute! I don't even remember
passing out any videos!
IT-WAS-MY-FAULT.
What?

I-APOLOGIZE.
I-SHOULD-HAVE-BEEN-MORE-CAREFUL.

N-No, Monodam...
It's not your fault.

It's all our fault!
I'm sorry, too!
Ah, it seems I misunderstood.

I completely forgot that the plan all along
was to redistribute the videos.
D-Daddy!

It's not your fault at all, kids.
It's my fault for forgetting.
Fatherrrrr!
THANK-GOODNESS.

Wh-What the hell is this mushy,
feel-good crap!?

You're all idiots! I'm through <CLT=cltSTRONG>getting along<CLT=cltNORMAL>
with you dummy bears!

I'm sorry to cause so much trouble.
Please continue your boring conversation.

I see... The Monokubs merely distributed the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>motive videos<CLT=cltNORMAL> at random...

Receiving my own video was nothing more
than...bad luck.

...So you just watched it without knowing
why it was given to you?
What was in your video?
...Well? You promised to tell us everything.

I will tell you the truth in its entirety, but...
I doubt that everyone will believe it.

If that's the case, why don't we all watch
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive video<CLT=cltNORMAL> together?

Yes, that would be much better!
Let's hurry before Daddy gets bored again!

How thorough of you... Yet I suppose
it is better this way.

Perhaps the truth will be easier to believe
if you witness it with your own eyes.

<CLT=cltMIND>After Kirumi had spoken, the
Monokubs began playing the video.

Alright! Back by popular demand,
it's time for the <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive video<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

Who's the <CLT=cltSTRONG>most important person in *your* life<CLT=cltNORMAL>?
And now, without further ado...
Kirumi Tojo, the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Maid<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

With clients in politics and finance, this elite
maid is renowned for completing any request.
One fateful day...

She was suddenly summoned by one of her
most influential clients—the prime minister.

The prime minister had a request of
utmost importance.

He requested that she use her talent as the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Maid<CLT=cltNORMAL> to serve her country.

He asked Kirumi to <CLT=cltSTRONG>"make this country great
again,"<CLT=cltNORMAL> and transferred all his authority to her.

No one suspected that the prime minister's new
secretary was secretly running the country...

And over time, she became the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>de facto prime minister<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

Only Kirumi could save the country from
<CLT=cltSTRONG>impending doom<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Yes! The future of the country rests
entirely on her capable shoulders!

But Kirumi is up to the task, for she only
accepts requests that only she can fulfill.

She is driven by the belief that her citizens are
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>most important people in her life<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Oh, and while we're on the subject
of those important people...

An unfortunate event will soon befall
those vermin and sheeple.

What event, you ask? It's a secret!
Find out for yourself. Puhuhuhuhuhu...
...It can't be...

What...the hell?
The prime minister?

Everything you just saw is true, though I only
remembered it upon watching that video.
<CLT=cltMIND>Remembered...?

P-Please, hold on!
That video...is true!?

Th-That's ridiculous! There's no way
Kirumi's really the prime minis—
No, it's the truth.

I am Kirumi Tojo, the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Maid<CLT=cltNORMAL>, and the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>most important people<CLT=cltNORMAL> to me...
...are the citizens of this country!

I was <CLT=cltSTRONG>called upon<CLT=cltNORMAL> to lift the country out
of a dire situation.
I swore to serve and help all its citizens.

As the Ultimate Maid, I have advised
politicians many times in the past...

But he wanted me to prioritize saving the
country from an <CLT=cltSTRONG>unprecedented crisis<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
I fully accepted this request.

As a maid, it is a great honor to serve
the nation itself.

You're literally confusing the shit outta me, cuz
this makes no sense and I gotta take a dump.

I see... So Kirumi was the real prime minister,
running the country behind the scenes.

...How can you seriously believe that a
high schooler could be prime minister!?

I don't think it's odd that an <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=cltNORMAL>-level
talent could be *that* powerful.

I mean, Kee-boy's talent lets him pretend to
be human, even though he's a heartless robot.

How rude! I am not pretending!
I am still learning!

U-Uh...I see.
Well...good luck, I guess.

I was aware of Kirumi's impressive
talents, but prime minister...
Then...Kirumi really is prime minister?
She hold burden of country's future!?

The <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive video<CLT=cltNORMAL> aside, Kirumi doesn't seem 
like she'd lie about something like that...

Hey, hey! I get that Kirumi is really important,
but what was that <CLT=cltSTRONG>unprecedented crisis<CLT=cltNORMAL>?
I...I don't know, actually.
Why can't I <CLT=cltSTRONG>remember<CLT=cltNORMAL>?
With our memories lost...

Wait...isn't this just like the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

Perhaps...it is connected to the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

The <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltNORMAL> is connected to this
<CLT=cltSTRONG>unprecedented crisis facing the nation<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

If that's true...how are they connected?
What is this <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltNORMAL>, anyway?

I do not know what is happening to the nation
while I am here, inside the <CLT=cltSTRONG>End Wall<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
That is why I needed to know.

I needed to know that the <CLT=cltSTRONG>most important
people in my life<CLT=cltNORMAL> were safe.

Because I am duty and honorbound to protect
<CLT=cltSTRONG>every citizen of this nation<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
That is why...I needed to escape.

So you weighed our lives against the 
lives of everyone else in the nation.

But...if those are the options, of course
you'd pick everyone outside, right?

There's...just too many lives
at stake out there.

And we just stopped Kirumi from doing
that, because we selfishly wanted to live...

Wh-What should we do?
D-Did we just make a terrible mistake?

If everyone outside dies because Kirumi
is dead...

Doesn't that mean we pretty much destroyed
the country!? Wh-What do we do!?

S-Say...what's Monokuma planning to do
with the rest of humanity?

You know how many people live in this
country? Like a hundred million, easily...

No matter how powerful the mastermind
is, there's no way they could really-
Bears do not lie!
Bears do not lie!

I am the ruler of <CLT=cltSTRONG>this world<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
Nothing is beyond my power.

Nothing is beyond your power?
What kind of arrogant, ridiculous—

That is 100% a lie! It is impossible that
he could bring disaster to a country!
Puhu... Puhuhuhu.
What's so funny?

You guys act like you can't believe it,
but you're all terrified anyway.

If you can't believe it...then you're
terrified for no reason.

Why do humans lie!? Why are humans
the only animal that tells lies!?
Kyahahahahahaha!

H-Hey! Cut it out!
This is serious!

How long are you gonna keep talking
about Kirumi?

Let's talk about Ryoma. It would be
a shame to completely neglect him.

That's right. We know your motive to kill,
but why did you kill Ryoma specifically?
Because he was easy to kill...
Easy to kill?

Ryoma not that weak! When he use his <CLT=cltSTRONG>Shukuchi
Method<CLT=cltNORMAL>, even Gonta no could catch—

His physical strength was irrelevant when
he did not have a <CLT=cltSTRONG>reason to live<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Without that, he became the weakest
among us.
What?

I...took advantage of his weakness, and
killed him.
What do you mean?

I told him I had urgent matters to discuss, and
to meet me in the research lab on the 3rd floor.

There, I revealed my <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive video<CLT=cltNORMAL>, and
afterward I told him...

"I am responsible for the life of every citizen
of this nation, so I must escape this place."
He then responded...

So...you got a reason to survive...
That's the complete opposite of me...
Heh... That's good...

If you've got something to live for,
it means your life has value.
Hmph...

After he said that, he told me he would
clean up the tennis balls lying around...
And then, he turned his back toward me.
At that moment, my determination solidified.

A person like him would have noticed my 
bloodthirst emanating. He already knew...
He forfeited his life right then and there...

That is when I decided I must sacrifice his
life for my nation and my people.

Then Ryoma...knew he was going
to be killed...

Wait a minute, it's Maki's fault that Ryoma
decided he didn't want to live anymore.
...What?

Ryoma only gave up on life after you showed
him his <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive video<CLT=cltSTRONG>.

Well, since you didn't watch his <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive video<CLT=cltNORMAL>,
I guess you had no way of knowing...
...What's your point?

Wait a minute, you're talking as if Ryoma
saw that <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive video<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

Didn't you just say that he only checked
the name and didn't watch the video?
Huuuh? Did I say that?
...What are you getting at?

I probably shouldn't say anything...but someone
has to step up and speak for poor Ryoma.

Again, what's your point? That he gave up on
life because I showed him his <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive video<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

I'll get to that in a sec, but why do you think
Ryoma wanted to see his <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive video<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

Cuz he was looking for a reason to live.
Isn't that right, Maki?
How...do you know that?

...Swap motive videos? Didn't we agree not
to show them to each other?

Yeah, I remember... Cause once you
watch 'em, you've got a <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive to kill<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

But...if it shows <CLT=cltSTRONG>someone important
to me<CLT=cltNORMAL>, I'd really like to see that.
...Any idea who'll be in the video?

I don't...
That's why I want to see it.

Once I know I've got someone important
to me, I'll have a reason to live...

If I've got a reason to live, then I've got 
a reason to escape here with you guys.

In other words, that video might just
give me a <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive to live<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
So please...

...You're right. He was looking for a reason
to live.

Which means you shouldn't have shown him
his <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive video<CLT=cltNORMAL> in the first place.

Wh-What do you mean?
What...did his video show?
Nothing—his motive was empty.
...Empty?

Oh, we're up next!
Let's give it a watch, shall we?

Alright! Back by popular demand,
it's time for the <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive video<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

Who's the <CLT=cltSTRONG>most important person in *your* life<CLT=cltNORMAL>?
And now, without further ado...

This message is for Ryoma Hoshi,
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Tennis Pro<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

Unfortunately, there is no one in the world
who is important to you!

I'm so sorry. Really, I am.
You have my deepest sympathies.
Sorry, sorry, sorry!

<CLT=cltMIND>No one...
No one was important to him?

Th-That's what he was shown...?
If he saw something like that...

He had none to care for and none who 
cared for him. He found no motive to live...

Because of that, he chose to let
Kirumi claim his life...
So...that's why...

He must have just watched that video
before I summoned him to met with me.
He just...gave up, then?

To hell with that!
That damn moron!

It's bad to have no reason to live, but it's
also bad to have too many reasons to live.

That's why you did such a terrible thing,
right Kirumi? For too many reasons.
You are free to judge me for killing Ryoma...

I would bear the burden of being seen as evil
for the sake of my nation and its people.

Because *that* is what it means to serve
with <CLT=cltSTRONG>selfless devotion<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
That's why I needed to survive.

Sacrificing you all meant saving the lives
of men, women, children, and elderly...
I...wanted to live.
Kirumi...
Monokuma... Gonta have question...
Oh? What is it!?
Can Gonta be blackened instead of Kirumi?
What?

Gonta... not smart boy, but even Gonta
understand what everyone saying.

Kirumi should live, not Gonta!
World needs her!
I was thinking the same thing...

I don't wanna die, but <CLT=cltSTRONG>Kirumi's life is way
more valuable than mine<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Kirumi's got the lives of hundreds of
millions of people on her shoulders, right?

Logically, Kirumi's survival would result in fewer
casualties than our collective survival would.

Geez... Maybe it would've been better
if we'd gotten the culprit wrong...
...What do you mean?

If Kirumi survives...then the nation's
future will be secure.

<CLT=cltMIND>Then...what was the
point of me doing all this...?

<CLT=cltMIND>Why did I reveal the truth?
What have I done...?

<CLT=cltMIND>Was I wrong? I-I 
shouldn't have—

What kind of face is that, Shuichi?
If you're my sidekick, then suck it up!
...What?

That goes for all of you! To hell 
with all this <CLT=cltSTRONG>value of life<CLT=cltNORMAL> shit!

Life's not just some thing! You can't 
trade it or put a price on it!
Kaito...
And your life doesn't just belong to you.

It's for your parents, your grandparents,
your friends, even your neighbors.

It's not something you can just decide 
to throw away on your own.

So we didn't do the wrong thing!
Life's purpose is to be <CLT=cltSTRONG>lived<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

As long as you stay alive, anything's
possible. You can even go to the stars...

So I'm just gonna go ahead and say it!
I wanna live!

I haven't even traveled to space yet.
There's no way in hell I'm gonna die here!
*sigh*... The idiot's talking again.

But...he's right. I mean, you're right, too.
He is an idiot. But he's right...
Yep! He's an Atua-damned idiot!

Hahahaha! I dunno why, but idiots
always fill me with inspiration!

H-Hey, shut up!
I told you to stop calling me an idiot!

Maybe his stupid speech is just what we needed
to hear. Kirumi certainly looks shaken by it.
Huh? Shaken...?

Do you really think someone as desperate
to live as Kirumi would give up so easily?

Of course not. In fact, she probably still hasn't
given up, even now.

She was hoping that learning the truth would
make one of us volunteer to die in her place.
...What!?

But Monokuma would never allow a blackened
to escape punishment, so maybe...

...she wanted everyone to rebel, so she could
use that as cover to escape on her own.
...How about it, Kirumi? Am I close?

You...are the most detestable cretin
I have ever met.

You knew exactly what I would attempt, yet
allowed me to explain anyway.
Wait, what he just said was true!?

You...try to trick Gonta!?
Try to trick everyone!?
Seriously!? You back-stabbing cunt!

Enough! She was just trying to
stay alive in her own way.
Nobody can blame her for that!
That's right... I must survive...

Because...I carry the weight of an entire
nation on my shoulders.

I would not have killed Ryoma if I was
so easily deterred.

This request will not be fulfilled until I have
brought joy to every citizen of this nation...
So no matter what, I cannot die!

That is why I killed Ryoma!
Even now, I refuse to give up!
Kirumi...?

You still refuse to give up.
So...what do you intend to do?
I intend to live...
I must survive...no matter what it takes...

If I must debase myself, so be it! I would
drink filth and eat carrion to survive!
I will do anything—ANYTHING!—to survive!

<CLT=cltMIND>She screamed...
and she started running.
AAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!

<CLT=cltMIND>I couldn't believe what I
was seeing.

<CLT=cltMIND>It was a completely
undignified exit.
I have to escape! I won't die here!

Puhuhuhuhu! There's no way I'm
letting you outta here!
AAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHH!!!!!

<CLT=cltMIND>It was ugly, and raw, and feral...
She just ran as fast as she could.
<CLT=cltMIND>...I heard my voice call out.
R-Run...
Run! Run, Kirumi!!!
Please ruuuun!!!
Run! Please hurry!
Hurry! Run!
Like I said...I'm not letting you leave.
Please! Ruuuuuun!!!

I will live! I refuse to die in a hellhole 
like this!

Now then, I've prepared a special punishment
for Kirumi Tojo, the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Maid<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
For my nation! For my people!

Let's give it everything we've got!
It's...PUNISHMENT TIME!!!
I WILL NOT DIIIIIIIIIIIE!!!!!
Yes
No
Something wrong?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Leave the area?
